# OCNJ Weekly Rentals

> Ocean City, New Jersey vacation rental search and booking service operated by Bob Idell Real Estate. Serving families since 2016 with 18,000+ rental properties in America's Greatest Family Resort.

## Quick Facts About Ocean City, NJ
- 8 miles of beaches, beach tags required ages 12+ ($30-35/season in 2026)
- 2.5-mile boardwalk open year-round, no admission fee
- Dry town since 1909 - no alcohol sales (BYOB restaurants welcome)
- Population: ~11,000 year-round, 130,000+ in summer
- Known as "America's Greatest Family Resort"
- Dogs NOT allowed on beach/boardwalk May 1 - September 30
- Water temperature: 65-75°F in summer
- Major events: Night in Venice (July), Baby Parade (August), Block Party (September)
